userStories.title: ExecutionGates SSOT for keep-open and review/rectification gates
acceptanceCriteria: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns false when both config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled are absent or false.
shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "test-writer") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "verifier") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
shouldRunReview(config) returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
shouldRunReview(config) returns false when config.review is absent.
shouldRunRectification(config) returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
shouldRunRectification(config) returns false when config.execution.rectification is absent.

Given `src/tdd/session-runner.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `role === "implementer" && (config.execution.rectification?.enabled ?? false)` expression.

Given `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `ctx.config.review?.enabled === true || ctx.config.execution.rectification?.enabled === true` expression.

userStories.title: SessionKeeper for rectification session reuse and retry canonicalization
acceptanceCriteria: SessionKeeper.send() returns the TurnResult from agentManager.runAsSession on success.
SessionKeeper.send() calls sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) before openSession, and when a live handle with matching agentName exists, SessionKeeper.send() reuses that handle.
Given no matching live handle exists, when SessionKeeper.send() runs, then it calls sessionManager.openSession and uses the returned handle.
Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy.shouldRetry returns retry: true, then SessionKeeper.send() closes the stale handle and retries.
Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy is absent or returns retry: false, then SessionKeeper.send() re-throws the error.
Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: false, when SessionKeeper.send() handles the error, then it re-throws immediately without calling retryStrategy.shouldRetry.
SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() calls sessionManager.bindHandle(heldHandle.id, sessionName, protocolIds) when heldHandle.protocolIds is defined.
SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() performs no sessionManager.bindHandle call when heldHandle.protocolIds is undefined.
SessionKeeper.close() calls sessionManager.closeSession for the held handle when one exists and does not throw when no handle is held.

Given `src/verification/rectification-loop.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.

Given `src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.

userStories.title: StoryOrchestratorBuilder to unify execution and TDD orchestration
acceptanceCriteria: Given addImplementer was never called, when StoryOrchestratorBuilder.build(ctx) is invoked, then it throws NaxError with code "ORCHESTRATOR_NO_IMPLEMENTER".

Given slots are declared in order, when ExecutionPlan.run() executes, then it runs test-writer (if added), implementer, verifier (if added), semantic review (if added), and rectification (if added) in that order.
When an add* method is not called for a phase, then ExecutionPlan.run() skips that phase and does not emit that phase key in phaseOutputs.

ExecutionPlan.run() stores per-phase costs in phaseCosts keyed by op name, stores parsed phase outputs in phaseOutputs keyed by op name, and sets totalCostUsd equal to the numeric sum of phaseCosts values.

Given `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` is inspected after US-004, when locating story execution orchestration, then the file uses StoryOrchestratorBuilder/ExecutionPlan and does not contain residual duplicated session-loop orchestration guarded by `if (isTddStrategy)`.

Given `src/tdd/orchestrator.ts` is inspected after US-004, when locating story execution orchestration, then the file uses StoryOrchestratorBuilder/ExecutionPlan for phase sequencing and does not keep independent duplicated session-loop orchestration.
When tdd/orchestrator.ts processes verifier completion through StoryOrchestratorResult, then it reads `phaseOutputs["verifier"]` and applies `readVerdict()` and `categorizeVerdict()`.
Given StoryOrchestratorResult.success is false and config.tdd.rollbackOnFailure is true, when tdd/orchestrator.ts completes plan.run(), then it triggers rollback to initialRef.

analysis: Current code confirms the split orchestration design and duplication targeted by the spec. `executionStage` has a TDD branch (`src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts:48-63`) and a separate single-session path with independent `keepOpen` logic (`src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts:161`). TDD session runner computes `keepOpen` differently (`src/tdd/session-runner.ts:213`), which matches the spec’s divergence root cause. Rectification retry/reuse is duplicated in two `while (true)` loops with similar flow: `getLiveHandle -> openSession -> runAsSession -> retry/close` in `src/verification/rectification-loop.ts:321-394` and `src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts:309-378`; these are the exact extraction points for SessionKeeper. There is a real bind canonicalization mismatch in code today: rectification loop binds with `sessionId` (`src/verification/rectification-loop.ts:394`) while gate binds with `heldHandle.id` (`src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts:378`), matching US-002 requirements. TDD ops are currently minimal role tags via `TddRunOp` in `src/tdd/session-op.ts:19-25` and are dispatched by calling `runTddSession` directly (`src/tdd/session-op.ts:105`), so US-003 requires a real migration to `RunOperation` + `callOp`. Operation infrastructure already supports this shape (`src/operations/types.ts`, `src/operations/call.ts`). Existing operation exports still expose TDD tag types (`src/operations/index.ts`), and that export must be removed to satisfy spec ACs. `executionGatesConfigSelector` and `ExecutionGatesConfig` already exist in selectors (`src/config/selectors.ts`), so US-001 should create behavior helpers in `src/operations/execution-gates.ts` and consume selector output rather than creating new config plumbing. TDD orchestration currently includes rollback and verdict handling in `src/tdd/orchestrator.ts` (`rollbackTddFailureIfNeeded` at lines 21-44 and verdict imports at line 17), so Phase 2 must keep these behaviors in the thin wrapper while moving sequencing/session lifecycle into the builder result flow. Tests confirm which ones are wiring-specific and should be removed (`test/unit/tdd/session-runner-keep-open.test.ts`, `test/unit/tdd/rectification-gate-session.test.ts`, `test/unit/tdd/session-runner-bindhandle.test.ts`, `test/unit/tdd/session-op.test.ts`, `test/unit/pipeline/stages/execution-tdd-simple.test.ts`, `test/integration/tdd/rectification-gate-orchestrator.test.ts`) and which behavior suites should remain/adjust (`test/unit/verification/rectification-loop.test.ts`, `test/unit/tdd/rectification-gate.test.ts`, `test/integration/tdd/tdd-orchestrator-core.test.ts`, `test/integration/tdd/tdd-orchestrator-verdict.test.ts`, `test/unit/verification/rectification-loop-escalation.test.ts`). Main risks are session lifecycle regressions (open/close/reuse), retry behavior drift after extraction, and preserving current TDD wrapper semantics (rollback/verdict/isolation) during builder unification. Migration path should stay phased: US-001/US-002/US-003 first, then US-004.
